interface.dispatcher: Separate MM2S and S2MM command ready/valid and completion valid/ready, bank-ID completion tags and error codes
interface.vendor_datamover: 72-bit command, 64-bit data and 8-bit status AXI streams in each direction
interface.local_bank: smollm2_dma_bank_bridge role 1 write and role 2 read ports
interface.completion_tag: Engine sequence tags are used only for status validation; dispatcher sees the corresponding bank ID

control_rules.load_completion: Requires DataMover matching success status and last local adapter write completion
control_rules.store_completion: Requires adapter read/stream completion and DataMover matching success status that represents DDR write completion
control_rules.high_offset: Any 32-bit ISA local offset with bits 31:23 set becomes aligned out-of-capacity descriptor 06 instead of truncating
control_rules.bridge_fault: Bridge load/store direction fault drives corresponding engine scheduler abort, which emits error code 50; separate bridge code and bank outputs identify the local cause. An already-offered response remains stable while READY is low
control_rules.transport_fault: Engine status fault produces error completion, holds metadata head and requires coordinated system reset
control_rules.recovery: recovery_required remains asserted until reset; board controller must reset this link, vendor DataMover IP and dispatcher together

required_cases: LOAD waits for local write and matching DataMover status
STORE waits for DDR status after stream completion
bank-ID response translation and engine sequence tag diagnostics
high ISA offset rejected without DDR issue
bridge permission fault becomes command error
required_tools: self-checking XSIM with modeled DataMover streams
verification.proof_scope: model DMA control and stream/local-bank interface; no vendor AXI DataMover IP, DDR transaction model, board placement or Vitis execution
